intro: A Dark Threat Looms is an urgent mission to protect Loch Modan from disaster. Alliance adventurers are tasked with deploying a neutralizing chemical against a planted explosive charge before catastrophic damage can be dealt to the Stonewrought Dam.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you so much, friend!! You have saved the Stonewrought Dam! Without your help, the Dark Iron terrorists would have surely seen to this mighty landmark's demise. You have made the Kingdom and the Alliance proud, brave adventurer.
The Dam is once again safe... For the time being at least....

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
